item.title: First At-Sea Worship Service Held Aboard PCU John F. Kennedy
item.description: PCU John F. Kennedy's Command Religious Ministry Department (CRMD) Holds Church Service For The First Time While Underway During Builder's Trials.

item.title: Arctic Angels strike at night: 1/11 IBCT Air Assaults into fight during JPMRC 26-02
item.description: Under clear Arctic skies and in the cover of darkness, Soldiers assigned to the 1st Infantry Brigade Combat Team (Air Assault), 11th Airborne Division, executed a nighttime air assault to counter an opposing force (OPFOR) airborne insertion during Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center 26-02.

item.title: 120th Infantry Battalion Soldiers receive equipment ahead of CENTCOM deployment
item.description: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to the 120th Infantry Battalion 30th Army Brigade Combat Team received newly fielded equipment in preparation for their upcoming deployment in support of U.S. Central Command on Feb. 5, 2026, at Fort Bliss, Texas.

item.title: Goldwater Air National Guard Base hosts 2nd Annual Hazmat Jamboree
item.description: Emergency management Airmen and partner agencies from across Arizona participated in the 2nd Annual Arizona Air National Guard Hazmat Jamboree hosted by the 161st Air Refueling Wing to strengthen technician-level hazardous materials skills, improve interoperability and build professional relationships.

item.title: MACOMB-BASED ARMY NATIONAL GUARD ENGINEER UNIT COMPLETES MISSION IN MIDDLE EAST, RETURNS TO ILLINOIS
item.description: More than 150 Soldiers from the Illinois Army National Guard’s 661st Engineer Construction Company returned to Illinois this month after completing their mission in the Middle East. About 50 Soldiers returned on February 7 and the remaining approximately 100 Soldiers returned on February 14 (Valentine’s Day). item.title: Leadership, Vision, Excellence: Iwo Jima Sailor Awarded Prestigious Admiral Zumwalt Award for Visionary Leadership
item.description: Visionary leadership, operational excellence, and humility: these are but a few traits that make an effective leader within the U.S. Navy. item.title: Faces of Readiness: LT Mackenna Smith Supporting the Warfighter in Rota
item.description: ROTA, Spain (Jan. 3, 2026) — Lt. Mackenna Smith, a native of Los Angeles, is assigned to Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command (NMRTC) Rota, where she serves as a registered nurse in the Multi Service Ward Department, providing inpatient medical care to a wide spectrum of patient populations requiring acute and ongoing medical treatment.

item.title: Australia, Philippines, and U.S. Conduct a Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity
item.description: SOUTH CHINA SEA — The combined armed forces of Australia, the Philippines, and the United States, demonstrated a collective commitment to strengthen regional and international cooperation in support of a free and open Indo-Pacific while conducting a multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity (MCA) within the Philippines’ Exclusive Economic Zone, Feb. 15-16, 2025.

item.title: Chabelley Airfield adds on-site firearms training capability
item.description: Chabelley Airfield marked a major operational milestone with the opening of its small arms range, a $1.6 million project that significantly expands on-site training capacity and operational flexibility for U.S. and partner forces.
